title: WONDERFUL, BEAUTIFUL POSITIVE PROMISES

blocks.text: “In this particular special writing the Holy Spirit has chosen to give us some wonderful, beautiful and positive promises! Keep and use them daily or in time of need!” – “I have given them thy Word! (St. John 17:14) – that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble! – Meaning the Word works in any situation, sickness, problems, etc.” – “The Bible says He sent His Word and delivered them!” – Ps. 103:2, “Bless the Lord, O my soul, and FORGET not all His BENEFITS! David went on to say that, He forgives all sins and heals all diseases! He went a step further in verse 5 and declared divine health for all those that take proper care of their body and believed!”

Ps. 105:37, “And this Scripture is definitely for the elect of our day, that is all who can appropriate it in faith!” – “He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes! – This alone reveals healing, divine health and abundance of prosperity for those who accept the authority of these faithful Scriptures!” – Verse 39, “He will even spread a cloud and protect us and a pillar of fire to guide us! Amen!” – “In verse 43 combined with this He will give you joy and gladness even in perilous times!”

Mark 16:17-18, “Jesus said these signs of miracles would follow them that believe!” Verse 20 says, “That He would confirm His Word with signs following!” – Matt. 7:8 says, “Everyone that asketh receiveth; he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened!” – “It says everyone that asketh, receiveth, but people have a hard time believing this every time they pray; and you cannot get everyone to believe it, but the Scriptures mean exactly what it says! Everyone that asketh definitely receiveth but they cannot all believe it and it gradually slips away from them because they do not hold to it or trust in the proper way!” St. John 14:12, “Verily, verily, I say unto you, he that believeth on me, (clinging and acting on His Word) the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do.” Because He would turn back into the Holy Spirit, coming in His name with great power to us! Verses 8-9 confirmed this! Verse 14 says, “If you believe truly in your heart that when you have seen Jesus you have seen the Father then you shall ask anything in My name and I will do it! Study these segments of Scripture closely and you shall add faith, anointing and spiritual contentment to your heart!” – Jesus said in one place, I AND MY FATHER ARE ONE! I came in His name Lord Jesus Christ! (St. John 5:43) – Isa. 9:6 says, “The Everlasting Father, the Prince of Peace!” – “Behold saith the Lord, read ye St. John 13:13, Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I Am!” “When one unites his mind in unity with the Lord Jesus like this then he can ask and receive whatsoever he saith in health, healing and prosperity! And he can move mountains of problems and aggravation out of the way!” (Mark 11:23)

Matt. 21:22, “All things whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive!” – St. John 15:7-8, “If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you! His Word within you with praise is very effective in any manner!” – I John 5:14-15, “And this is the confidence that we have in Him, that, if we ask anything according to His will (that means concerning all His promises) He truly heareth us!” – “The Bible absolutely is definite that He always hears you, but you must believe that He does!” – Ps. 50:15, “Call upon Me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify Me!”

Luke 17:6, “So if ye had faith as a mustard seed (the tiniest of seeds) it says you could pluck up a tree and plant it in the sea and it would do exactly as you said it would do!” – Mark 9:23, “Jesus said, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth!” – “That is acting on His Word and actually clinging to the promise as though you had it all the time!” – “Even though you cannot see it you know that it is yours!” Phil. 3:13, “I can do all things through Christ which strengthens me!” – “Like in Luke 6:38 it says, Give and it shall be given!” – “It reveals a change in the mind to action!” – “And you say in your heart, I don’t have this sickness anymore; Jesus has taken it away already! Because the Scriptures say, By whose stripes you WERE healed!” (I Peter 2:24) – “It confirms it in the Old Testament, Isa. 53:5, and in the New Testament!” – “Just account what you want done as being finished and hold to His Word always! – Better yet, trust ye in the Lord forever!” (Isa. 26:4)
